violation_type.title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §746.4601(2))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions
violation_type.typical_finding: A one year old child was allowed to play on playground equipment that is designed for children ages five through twelve, resulting in an injury that required medical attention.

finding_variants.text: A one year old child was allowed to play on playground equipment that is designed for children ages five through twelve, resulting in an injury that required medical attention.
A circle cycle was observed on the playground on concrete.
The equipment appears to be residential in nature and the operation does not have manufacturer instructions available for review.

It was determined that the operation was not utilizing a piece of outdoor equipment per the manufacturer's instructions or guidelines. The equipment is intended to be a crawling toy instead of a climber.
A child's accidental play injury occurred at the playground on a play structure that was not intended for the child's age, according to the play structures manual.
2 and 3 year olds were observed playing on equipment that were manufactured for ages 5 and up.
